messages.subject: Re: Fwd: Data Mining Survey
messages.body_plain:
Thanks Tony for encouraging respondents to this survey.  Others may be
interested in this comment from Bob Muenchen (author of the R for SAS
and SPSS users book) - if you use R for data mining, why not respond -
unfortunately such survey's don't really mean too much, except perhaps
which vendor was most effective in encouraging respondents.... all the
same - would be interesting if there was a strong R response.

wrote:

>>Fourth Annual Data Miner Survey
>>Rexer Analytics has asked statistical and data mining software vendors

>>

>>  Feedback: http://oit.utk.edu/feedback/

On Apr 23, 2:22 pm, tony nolan <Tony.No...@uts.edu.au> wrote:
> Hi Everyone,
>
> If your interested in Data Mining, then you might like to take part
> in this software survey. It takes a little time to fill it out,
> however, you can request a report on their findings. It mentions a
> whole gambit of tools, there is even a R option in one of the boxes.
> I for one would be interested in the intelligence provided in this
> survey, to see just what the industry in general is using, plus I
> would like to see the figures on R users, to see how much opensource
> R tools like Rattle have entered the general marketplace.
>
> Regards
> Tony
>
> http://www.rexeranalytics.com/Data-Miner-Survey-2010-Intro2.html

messages.subject: Rattle 2.5.31 released - maintenance release
messages.body_plain:
Rattle version 2.5.31 is now available on CRAN. This is a maintenance
release. Primary changes include:

  * Add rattle.info <http://rattle.info>() to list information for debugging purposes - for
use
    when reporintg bugs.

  * Bump pmml to 1.2.22 with fixes from wenchi...@zementis.com to
be
    more standards compliant and loadable into Zementis' on-line tool
    Extension in Header should be first element. Coefficients in
regression
    models should not be NA.

  * Various MS/Windows Japanese/French/German/Spanish updates.

  * Numerous minor bug fixes and tuning.

Full changelog is available from

  cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rattle/ChangeLog <http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rattle/ChangeLog>

and more details from

  cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rattle/index.html <http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rattle/index.html>

Regards,
Graham

--

messages.subject: Data Mining Survey – Last Call
messages.body_plain:
Data Mining Survey – Last Call

We want you to take the 4th Annual Data Miner Survey.  If you haven’t taken it yet, please click on the survey link and take it now.

Survey Link: www.RexerAnalytics.com/Data-Miner-Survey-2010-Intro2.html <http://www.rexeranalytics.com/Data-Miner-Survey-2010-Intro2.html>
Access Code:  RY63U

The survey will take approximately 20 minutes to complete.

Please also forward this email to other data miners in your network.  Your help in spreading the word is essential for getting a large and diverse sample of data miners.  Anyone who has had this email forwarded to them can use the access code in the forwarded email.

Thank you to all the data miners who have already completed the survey and have told others about it.  You’ve helped us get over 500 responses so far.  We also wish to thank all the people in the data mining community who provided suggestions and helped shape this year’s research.  If you have ideas for new survey questions or ways to improve next year’s Data Miner Survey, please send your ideas to us.  This research is conducted each year by Rexer Analytics <http://www.rexeranalytics.com/>, and the results are made available to everyone via FREE Summary Reports.

We look forward to sharing the results with you, and to continuing to build on this research foundation each year.  We will announce the survey results this Fall at the Predictive Analytics World Conference <http://www.predictiveanalyticsworld.com/>.  At that time we will also post a bulleted summary of the results on KDnuggets <http://www.kdnuggets.com/> and distribute the full FREE Summary Report via email to everyone who requests it – there is a check box at the end of the survey to request the summary report.

Information about Rexer Analytics is available at www.RexerAnalytics.com <http://www.rexeranalytics.com/>.  Questions about this research program and the summary reports can be directed to DataMin...@RexerAnalytics.com <http://us.mc11.mail.yahoo.com/mc/compose?to=Dat...@RexerAnalytics.com>.  The free 48 page Summary Report for the 3rd Annual Data Miner Survey is available now.  If you want to receive a copy, just email us.

Thank you for your time.

-- Karl

======================

Karl Rexer, PhD

President, Rexer Analytics

www.RexerAnalytics.com <http://www.rexeranalytics.com/>

617-233-8185

--
